records.question: Jackson works 5 days a week going door-to-door collecting for charity. His goal is to raise $1000 for the week. He earned $300 on Monday and $40 on Tuesday. If he collects an average of $10 for every 4 houses he visits, how many houses will he have to visit on each of the remaining days of the week to meet his goal?
records.response:
Jackson needs to collect 1000 - 300 - 40 = $660 more to meet his goal.
He collects an average of $10 for every 4 houses he visits, so he needs to visit 660 / 10 = 66 houses to collect $660.
He has 5 - 2 = 3 days left in the week to collect $660.
So, he needs to visit 66 / 3 = 22 houses per day to meet his goal.
#### 22

records.response:
Jackson needs to earn $1000 - $300 - $40 = $660 in the remaining three days.
He needs to earn an average of $660 / 3 = $220 per day.
He earns $220 / $10 = 22 sets of 4 houses per day.
Thus, he will have to visit 22 * 4 = 88 houses per day.
#### 88

records.question: Ben works 8-hour shifts in a furniture shop.  It takes him 5 hours to build 1 rocking chair.  How many chairs can he build in 10 days?
records.response:
Ben works 8 hours per day, so in 10 days he works 8*10 = 80 hours.
It takes Ben 5 hours to build 1 rocking chair, so in 80 hours he can build 80/5 = 16 rocking chairs.
#### 16
